subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should ClawHub accept package release changelog auto-preview for authorized package publishers and staff, including use of prior release README content for preview generation?
rationale: The code review can verify the access gate, but a contributor PR is adding a new public action that reads package release storage and may call OpenAI, so the permanent product/security boundary needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept gated preview after rebase
options.body: Resolve the current `convex/packages.ts` conflict, keep the owner/publisher/staff access gate before storage reads, and land the proven preview path.

options.title: Narrow the preview contract
options.body: Require stricter access, less README context, or explicit policy documentation before merging the preview action.

options.title: Keep changelogs manual-only
options.body: Close or pause this PR if package release changelog auto-preview is not desired.

recommendation.title: Accept gated preview after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the current `convex/packages.ts` conflict, keep the owner/publisher/staff access gate before storage reads, and land the proven preview path.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main history across the package publish backend, plugin publish route, and the conflicting staged publish changes.
